c0063: The minimum this workbook asks for (see "Instructions"): a cushion below 3 months does not cover a slow stretch, such as the summer dip in July and August or a corporate client who pays late.
c0426: A round number often covers far less than the label says. This cushion is what keeps you open through the summer dip, when July and August bookings fall well below the rest of the year.
c0446: A loss in one year reduces taxable profit in later years. The model offsets losses fully as a simplification (federal rules cap the offset at 80% of taxable income). If you operate as a pass-through (sole proprietorship or LLC), set the rate to 0 and budget your personal tax separately, or keep it as a reserve for that tax, as the Word plan does.
